_description: Common migration scenarios — maps platform-specific patterns and features to Shopify equivalents

products.notes: WooCommerce product attributes map to Shopify product options (max 3). Custom fields → metafields.
gotchas: Variable products → Shopify variants (max 100)
Grouped products → Shopify bundles app
Downloadable products → Shopify Digital Downloads app

content.pages: Recreate as Shopify pages (Liquid) or use metaobjects for structured content
content.blog: Export blog posts via RSS → import to Shopify blog. Shopify blogs are simpler (no categories, limited taxonomy)
content.customPostTypes: No equivalent — use metaobjects, pages, or apps
content.widgets: No equivalent — use theme sections and app blocks
content.shortcodes: No equivalent — convert to Liquid snippets in custom Liquid sections

seo.urlRedirects: Critical — set up 301 redirects for all changed URLs via Shopify admin or bulk CSV
seo.metaTags: Handled via Shopify SEO settings per product/page/collection
seo.structuredData: Most themes include JSON-LD for products. May need custom for breadcrumbs, FAQs
gotchas: WordPress URL structures differ from Shopify (/product/ vs /products/)
Category URLs → collection URLs need redirects
Tag pages may not have direct Shopify equivalent

plugins.contactForm7: Shopify contact form section or form builder app
plugins.yoastSeo: Shopify handles basic SEO; use apps like SEO Manager for advanced
plugins.elementor: No visual builder — use Shopify theme customizer + sections
plugins.gravityForms: Hulk Form Builder or JEEMA Form Builder

migration.estimatedDays: 5-15 depending on catalog size and customization

products.method: Migration app or custom script via APIs
products.notes: Magento's attribute system is much more complex. Map key attributes to Shopify options/metafields.
gotchas: Configurable products → Shopify variants (option limit: 3 axes, 100 variants)
Bundled products → use Shopify Bundles app or line item properties
Custom options → product metafields + custom variant picker
Tiered pricing → Shopify Scripts (Plus) or pricing app
Multi-store → Shopify Markets or expansion stores (Plus)

content.cmsPages: Recreate as Shopify pages. Magento widget/block system → Shopify sections
content.cmsBlocks: Convert to Shopify Liquid snippets or custom Liquid sections
content.categories: Map to Shopify collections (manual or smart collections)

seo.urlRedirects: Essential — Magento URLs are very different
seo.layeredNavigation: Shopify Search & Discovery app or Boost Commerce
gotchas: Magento category tree → flat Shopify collection structure
Layered navigation URLs need redirect strategy

products.notes: BigCommerce product structure is similar to Shopify. Most fields map directly.
gotchas: BigCommerce allows more variant options (250+) vs Shopify (100)
Product rules/modifiers → metafields or customization apps

content.blog: Export/import blog posts — both platforms have similar blog capabilities

products.method: CSV export from Squarespace → format for Shopify import
products.notes: Squarespace product data is simpler. Export via Squarespace settings.
gotchas: Squarespace digital products → Shopify Digital Downloads app
Squarespace membership/subscription → use apps

content.pages: Recreate in Shopify. Squarespace's visual builder doesn't export to code cleanly
content.blog: Export via Squarespace → import to Shopify
content.galleries: Recreate using Shopify gallery sections or custom Liquid

design.notes: Squarespace designs tend to be very visual with custom layouts. Shopify section-based approach is more structured — may need creative section combinations or custom Liquid to replicate exact layouts.

products.method: CSV export from Wix → format for Shopify import
products.notes: Wix ecommerce is limited. Most products transfer easily.
gotchas: Wix product options don't always map cleanly to Shopify's 3-option limit

content.pages: Must be recreated. Wix uses a proprietary visual builder with no code export
content.blog: Export via RSS or Wix export → import to Shopify
content.dynamicPages: Wix dynamic pages → Shopify metaobjects + custom templates

design.notes: Wix allows pixel-perfect placement. Shopify themes are responsive and section-based. Exact layout replication is usually not possible — focus on equivalent UX, not pixel-perfect match.

products.method: VTEX API export → CSV format → Shopify import or Admin API
products.notes: VTEX has complex catalog structure with SKUs, specifications, and categories. Map specifications to metafields.
gotchas: VTEX SKU model differs from Shopify variants — may need to consolidate
VTEX product specifications → Shopify metafields
VTEX trade policies → Shopify Markets or customer-specific pricing (Plus)
VTEX marketplace integrations need re-evaluation for Shopify

content.pages: Recreate CMS content in Shopify pages or metaobjects
content.layouts: VTEX Site Editor layouts → Shopify theme sections
content.notes: VTEX CMS is very custom. Most content needs manual recreation.

seo.urlRedirects: Critical — VTEX URL patterns are very different from Shopify
gotchas: VTEX intelligent search → Shopify Search & Discovery or third-party
VTEX category tree → Shopify collections (flat structure)

migration.estimatedDays: 15-40 depending on catalog and customization complexity

products.method: SFCC data export via OCAPI or batch jobs → CSV → Shopify import
products.notes: SFCC has complex product model with master/variation products, product sets, and bundles. Requires careful mapping.
gotchas: SFCC variation groups → Shopify variants (max 100 variants, 3 options)
SFCC product sets → Shopify bundles app
SFCC catalogs → Shopify product types + collections
SFCC pricebooks → Shopify Markets pricing or Scripts (Plus)
SFCC content slots → Shopify sections
SFCC customer groups → Shopify customer tags + segmentation

content.pages: Recreate in Shopify. SFCC Content Assets → Shopify pages or metaobjects
content.contentSlots: SFCC Content Slots → Shopify theme sections + app blocks
content.pageDesigner: SFCC Page Designer components → Shopify sections (not 1:1 mapping)

seo.urlRedirects: Essential — SFCC URLs are completely different from Shopify structure
gotchas: SFCC uses /on/demandware.store/... URL patterns
Category URLs need comprehensive redirect mapping
SFCC's URL aliases may not have direct equivalents

integrations.notes: SFCC is often deeply integrated with Salesforce ecosystem (Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, CDP). Plan for replacement or re-integration.

commonReplacements.Order Management: Shopify's native OMS or third-party (Brightpearl, Linnworks)

products.method: API export to CSV → Shopify import or Shopify Admin API bulk create
products.notes: Requires understanding the custom system's data model and mapping to Shopify's.
gotchas: Custom product types → Shopify product types + metafields
Custom pricing logic → Shopify Scripts (Plus) or apps
Custom user auth → Shopify customer accounts (limited customization)
Custom checkout → Shopify checkout (standard plans: no customization; Plus: Checkout Extensibility)

content.notes: All content must be recreated using Shopify pages, sections, metaobjects, or custom Liquid

seo.urlRedirects: Map all existing URLs to Shopify URL structure. Set up 301 redirects.
seo.notes: Custom sites may have very different URL patterns — comprehensive redirect mapping is critical

gotchas: PrestaShop combinations → Shopify variants (100 max)
PrestaShop features → metafields

universalMigrationChecklist: Export all product data (CSV or API)
Export all customer data (with password reset plan)
Document all URL patterns for redirect mapping
Inventory all third-party integrations (payment, shipping, email, analytics)
Catalog all custom functionality for Shopify equivalent research
Plan SEO redirect strategy (301 redirects for all indexed URLs)
Plan email platform migration or integration
Post-launch: monitor 404s, test checkout flow, verify redirects
Audit all automation workflows (email flows, order processing rules) for recreation
Document API integrations for third-party services (ERP, WMS, CRM)
Plan staff training on Shopify admin
